HR Business Partner - International Role

Experienced HR professional with an international mindset?

We are looking for an experienced and trusted HR Business Partner who enjoys working close to managers, employees and colleagues at our headquarters in Pårup.

This is an international role in which you will support selected business areas across countries and cultures throughout the employee journey. You will advise managers on organisational development, employee relations, recruitment, employment conditions and day-to-day leadership matters. You will also be responsible for coordinating and developing MASCOT's trainee programmes.

You will join an experienced HR team and report to the HR Manager.

Your key responsibilities

• Advise and support managers on leadership, employee relations and organisational development

• Manage recruitment processes from job profile to final employment

• Handle employee cases, including absence, difficult conversations, terminations and exit interviews

• Ensure compliance with employment legislation, contracts, policies and local employment conditions

• Plan and quality-assure onboarding activities

• Support international HR projects, employee surveys, workshops and annual HR activities

• Coordinate trainee recruitment, training plans and ongoing development

• Collaborate with managers and colleagues across MASCOT's international organisation

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Consultant. You are confident in advising managers and comfortable handling both operational HR matters and broader organisational topics in an international business environment.

You are structured, responsible and able to move tasks from initiation to completion. You communicate clearly, listen carefully and build trusted relationships across functions, countries and cultures. You use your business understanding to combine sound judgement with a practical and solution-oriented approach.

Experience with recruitment, employment law, coaching, conflict management and HR systems is important. Knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors and LinkedIn Recruiter is an advantage.

You are fluent in written and spoken English. Fluency in another European language would be a strong advantage.

What we offer

At MASCOT, you become part of a family-owned international company with strong values, ambitious goals and short decision-making paths.

• An international HR role based at our headquarters in Pårup

• A permanent onsite position with close collaboration across the organisation

• A professional and supportive HR team

• Pension, health insurance and wellbeing initiatives

• Excellent food in our staff restaurant

• Employee discounts on MASCOT workwear

Ready to make a difference?

Apply today. We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

At MASCOT, we are united by passion, collaboration and the ambition to develop, manufacture and deliver the world's best workwear and safety footwear.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

• Support the planning, setup, and execution of global clinical trials, ensuring activities are delivered in accordance with timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Ensure trial oversight by maintaining accurate documentation and participating in inspection readiness activities.

• Collaborate with CROs and internal stakeholders to support site feasibility, selection, activation, and ongoing site management.

• Drive in the oversight of service providers, tracking deliverables, timelines, and quality to ensure alignment with study expectations.

• Support risk identification and mitigation activities, contributing to risk-based quality management throughout the trial lifecycle.

• Drive in managing protocol deviations and trial-level issues, ensuring proper documentation, follow-up, and escalation as needed.

• Support trial data review and performance tracking, contributing to reporting and identification of potential issues.

• Work collaboratively within a global, matrixed team environment, building strong relationships with internal teams, vendors, and investigators.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• 5+ years of experience in clinical trial management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

• Solid understanding of ICH/GCP regulations and the clinical drug development lifecycle.

• Experience managing global, multi-center trials and working in a complex, matrixed organization.

• Project management and service provider oversight skills.

• Good communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.

• Oncology and/or therapeutic area–specific experience is highly desirable.

The proposed gross annual base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK620.160,00---930.240,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on compensation and benefits will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Focus Sales Manager

We are looking for a new colleague to join our team in Denmark!

At ALSO, we believe that business grows stronger through collaboration. Every day, we work to make it easier for our partners to deliver smart IT solutions together with us. Our culture, built on trust, teamwork, and ambition, is a key driver behind our success as one of the leading IT distributors in Europe.

As Focus Sales Manager you will play a key role in driving strategic initiatives, strengthening partnerships, and identifying new commercial opportunities together with both vendors and partners.**Your key responsibilities

**As a Focus Sales Manager, your primary focus is to build strong, value-adding relationships with vendors, partners, and internal stakeholders. You will act as a bridge between strategy and execution and help translate opportunities into tangible results.

Your responsibilities include, among others:

• Working closely with our vendor on strategic priorities, including planning and execution of joint initiatives

• Driving commercial growth with a strong strategic mindset and a passion for spotting and realizing new business opportunities

• Building and maintaining strong relationships with key partners, and actively seeing the value in joint planning and collaboration

• Planning and executing sales and marketing activities in close cooperation with the vendor

• Developing in to a trusted advisor, capable of translating complex technology into simple, value-driven messages

• Supporting the sales organization with product knowledge, positioning, and commercial input

• Handling sales administration tasks efficiently and accurately, and following up on sales and purchase orders

• Taking part in presentations, partner meetings, and events – and feeling confident speaking in front of others

**

We invest in you**

From day one, you will be part of a structured onboarding program where you will be introduced to ALSO locally and regionally. You will receive training in the solutions, and go-to-market models, and you will work closely with your manager and colleagues to ensure a strong start in the role.

At ALSO, we highly value both professional and personal development and continuously support learning and growth opportunities.

Your qualifications

We imagine that you:

• Have a commercial and strategic mindset with a strong business understanding

• Thrive identifying opportunities and turning ideas into action

• Are a strong relationship builder who thrives in close collaboration with vendors and partners

• Are passionate about technology and can explain complex solutions in a simple and engaging way

• Feel comfortable presenting and speaking in front of groups

• Are a quick learner and fast at handling sales administration and coordination tasks

• Work in a structured and proactive way and are comfortable using Microsoft Office

• Are positive, outgoing, and contribute to a motivating and enjoyable work environment

• Experience from the IT industry or a similar commercial role is an advantage, but we also welcome applications from candidates early in their career who are eager to learn and develop within sales and vendor management.

Ready to join us on our journey?

Send us your application and CV, and let's talk about your future at ALSO.

Information at a Glance

Taastrup, DNK, 2630

Level of Experience:  Entry-Level

Job Function:  Sales

Required Travel:  less then 25%

About ALSO

ALSO is one of the leading technology providers for the ICT industry currently active in 30 countries in Europe and in a total of 144 countries worldwide. In 2024, net sales of the Swiss-based company, which employs about 4 200 people, amounted to 11 billion euros. The ALSO ecosystem offers around 135 000 resellers hardware, software and IT services from more than 800 vendors in over 1 570 product categories. In the spirit of the circular economy, the company provides all services from provision to refurbishment from a single source.

ALSO has three business models: The Supply division comprises the transactional range of hardware and software. The Solutions division supports customers in the development of customized IT solutions and ready-to-use IoT applications. Subscription-based cloud offerings for soft- and hardware as well as platforms for cybersecurity, IoT, virtualization and AI are the focus of the Service area.

For more information visit: www.also.com

ALSO Values

It is one of our fundamental values to respect human rights and to ensure that they are respected. This includes, in particular, respecting the personal dignity and privacy of each individual. Ethical behaviour is also expected of all our employees in business dealings with our partners. We are committed to fair, unrestricted competition and do not allow our decisions to be influenced by gifts or invitations, let alone financial benefits. Improving the lives of all people through technology - that is ALSO's goal. This also includes protecting our environment and making careful use of the limited resources we have. For further reference, please refer to our Code of Conduct.

Learn more about ALSO – THE TECHNOLOGY PROVIDER at: https://also.com | LinkedIn | Twitter | YouTube

Do you want to lead a coffee shop where coffee, great service, and community are our focus?

At Original Coffee, we serve good coffee – and we believe that good coffee and a good service creates an experience – the Original Coffee experience. So, if you’re passionate about excellent service, good coffee, sustainability, and leadership, this might be the perfect job for you!

Who are we?

Original Coffee is a fast-growing company and therefore we need more talented people to join our team. We have 21 coffee shops based around in Copenhagen and our coffee shops invites our guests to find calm, focus, and connection with themselves and others.

At Original Coffee our mission is to create an experience from the moment our guests step into our coffee shops. The experience, which we call the ‘OC experience’, is defined by our exceptional coffee and great service - key elements we consider equally important.

Your role as Store Manager

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to Original Coffee – brewed by friends.

Warranty Engineer - technical expert

At Körber Supply Chain, we are passionate about delivering innovative automation solutions that help our customers optimize their supply chains and stay competitive in a rapidly changing world. To support our continued growth, we are looking for a skilled and customer-focused Warranty Engineer who can combine technical expertise, project management, and customer engagement to ensure the successful handling and resolution of warranty-related issues across our advanced warehouse automation solutions.

Acting as the link between customers, engineering teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in driving customer satisfaction while contributing to the continuous improvement of our products and solutions.

As our Warranty Engineer, you will be responsible for investigating and resolving technical claims related to machine performance, malfunctions, and system reliability. You will perform root cause analyses, evaluate warranty entitlement, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure timely closure of warranty cases. At the same time, you will lead warranty-related projects from initiation to completion, managing timelines, stakeholders, risks, and communication throughout the process.

Success in this role requires close collaboration across functions. You will work alongside colleagues from Engineering, Standardization, Manufacturing, and Customer Service, while also building strong relationships with customers and suppliers. Through your structured and analytical approach, you will help identify opportunities for improvement and ensure that lessons learned are translated into sustainable solutions.

We are looking for a candidate with a degree in Marine Engineering (Maskinmester), Mechanical  Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a similar technical discipline, combined with experience from technical support, warranty management, project management, or related roles within manufacturing, automation, or industrial environments. Solid technical understanding of automation systems involving PLC control systems, electrical equipment, and mechanical components in industrial machines.

We welcome applications from both recent graduates who are eager to learn and develop within the role, as well as experienced professionals who can bring valuable knowledge, insights, and expertise to the team from day one.

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and solution-oriented. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You have a strong customer focus, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are motivated by solving complex challenges while delivering high-quality results.

At Körber Supply Chain, you will become part of an international and innovative organization where technology, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a dynamic working environment, opportunities for professional development, and the chance to make a tangible impact on the success of our customers and business.

If you are ready to take on a role where technical expertise meets customer value and project leadership, we would love to hear from you.

Why Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

At Körber Supply Chain, we believe that our people are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a range of attractive employee benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and work-life balance.

Security & Health

In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our pension scheme, which includes health and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy services. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen serves healthy and varied meals every day.

Learning & Development

We are committed to the continuous development of our employees and offer relevant training and development opportunities. Whether your goal is to strengthen your technical expertise, leadership capabilities, or professional skills, we support your growth and long-term career development.

A Strong Community

Our culture is built on collaboration, engagement, and strong relationships. Through our active employee association and various company events, you'll have plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues. Activities include Friday bars, Christmas parties, our annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more.

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

At Körber, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We celebrate diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. You can find out more about our culture here Culture at Körber - it's worth taking a look!

If you have any questions or technical problems, please send us an e-mail to jobs@koerber.com. Mette Maria Holmegaard Nielsen is the responsible person for this job advertisement. We work with permanent partners and therefore ask recruitment consultants to refrain from contacting us by e-mail or telephone.

At Körber, we think long term and pursue objectives that apply across all of our business areas. In line with our vision of “Market Leadership through Technology Leadership,” we have defined our “Life 2035” goals for the next decade to ensure that Körber becomes the leading partner in our industries—Life Science, Supply Chain, and High-Tech Manufacturing—by 2035.Life 2035 is built on four pillars that define how we embrace our shaping role: Leadership, Innovation, Findependence, and Empowerment. Sustainably profitable growth and financial independence form the foundation for achieving our ambitious financial targets for the next decade. By 2035, we aim to achieve global revenues of €10 billion. You can find more at https://www.koerber.com/en/about-us/what-drives-us

Körber is a global technology company for intelligent manufacturing and supply chain solutions. As a reliable innovation partner, Körber turns entrepreneurial thinking into customer success by providing leading technology to fuel what’s next – from end-to-end pharma production and advanced supply chain solutions to high-tech machinery and process equipment. Körber combines deep domain expertise with integrated hardware, software, and digital services, to help customers take the next step.

Do you want to work close to clients and help build one of Denmark’s best Business Central partners?

Kolding harbour with a tall ship, warehouses and reflections in the water — a few metres from DynaFlow’s offices

Our offices sit a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding.

At DynaFlow we are looking for an experienced Senior Business Central Consultant to join a team that knows the Business Central market from the inside. We bring many years of experience from larger consultancies, where we have led teams, built business and delivered complex client projects — and we use that experience to create confidence, clarity and solutions that hold up in practice.

About DynaFlow

At DynaFlow we believe in a different way of being a consultancy. Good advice does not start with technology, PowerPoints or processes — it starts with people, business and understanding.

We specialise in Dynamics NAV and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and have gathered more than 50 years of combined experience with solutions across industries, countries and organisations. Our clients range from large international groups to small and medium-sized businesses. For us, quality matters more than quantity, and we never leave a client stranded on the quayside.

About the role

As a Senior Business Central Consultant you take a central role in our work with clients. You become a trusted advisor and a strong professional sparring partner — close to the business and close to the people behind it.

You will work with advisory, solution design, implementation, support, optimisation and project management. Some tasks are about creating structure and momentum in complex ERP landscapes. Others are about making everyday work run more smoothly for the client. What they all have in common is that the solution has to make sense both now and in the longer term.

Your tasks will include:

• Analysing and mapping clients’ business processes

• Advising on the best possible use of Business Central

• Implementing, upgrading and developing Business Central solutions

• Operations, support, troubleshooting and ongoing sparring

• Project management and coordination across business, internal resources and vendors

• Close client relationships with a focus on presence and continuity

We imagine that you

• Have solid experience with Business Central/NAV, ideally at least 5 years

• Have strong business understanding from implementation, operations or advisory

• Can create clarity in complex solutions and turn needs into practical results

• Take independent ownership of clients, tasks and momentum

• Communicate clearly with management, key users, developers and partners alike

• Want to work closely with clients and build long-term relationships

• Thrive with freedom under responsibility, and bring humour and team spirit

• Speak and write fluent Danish, and preferably English

What we offer

• An important role in an ambitious, growing Business Central company

• The chance to help build one of the strongest Business Central environments in the country

• Plenty of freedom, flexibility and responsibility day to day

• Client relationships where presence and continuity actually matter

• Work for both international groups and small/medium-sized businesses

• Skilled colleagues with deep consulting and business experience

• The option to work from home and flexible working hours

• Canteen lunch scheme

• Pension with a health-insurance scheme

• Paid phone and internet

• Premium offices a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding

How to apply

Send your application and CV to kontakt@dynaflow.dk. We invite candidates to interviews on a rolling basis, so don’t hesitate to reach out.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to call Chris or Rasmus. We look forward to hearing from you.

Chris Erik Jensen

+45 36 20 70 13 cej@dynaflow.dk

Rasmus Torpe

+45 30 23 14 47 rto@dynaflow.dk

Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications

• 
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing

• 
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners

• 
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications

• 
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)

• 
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage

• 
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team

• 
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)

• 
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective

• 
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate

• 
Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)

• 
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture

• 
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.

• 
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)

• 
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks

• 
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting

• 
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

• 
Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry

• 
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

• 
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

• 
A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices

• 
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football

• 
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities

• 
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain

• 
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

• 
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales

• 
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to be a part of the development of our new e-commerce platform with more than 3.600 stores and 29 web shops? Or some of our more than 80 other java applications? In that case, come and join our Java department.

JYSK is a frontrunner in the development of online cross channel E-commerce. And with Unified Commerce, JYSK has launched its biggest IT initiative ever,

We are looking for a Student Software Engineer to join our Java Core team. In this role, you will not only support building applications - you will also support our Java developers across all agile teams.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We are in the middle of restructuring our IT landscape, turning it into a headless, event driven and microservice architecture. You will have a unique opportunity to build deep technical competencies while making a tangible difference for your colleagues.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• 
A student position averaging approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility around your studies because we believe your education comes first

• 
A relaxed and open-minded atmosphere

• 
Sparring and feedback from skilled colleagues at all levels in the organisation

• 
A job with rich possibilities to influence the demanding technical solutions

• 
A corporate culture with a short distance from thought to action

• 
A job where you get the opportunity to develop professionally and personally

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Student Software Engineer in the Java Core team, your mission is to create hyper-productivity through AI enablement while simultaneously raising the quality, security, and consistency across teams and codebases. You will help identify opportunities to leverage AI in software development and contribute to building scalable tools and solutions that enable developers to work more efficiently and deliver high-quality software.

Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

•

As a Business Analyst, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Together with your team, you will be engaged in commercial transformation projects for a variety of clients, where you will act as an advisor in building solutions for business challenges in a sales and/or service context. You will typically be involved in all project phases, focusing on understanding business objectives and identifying possible solutions, which will rely heavily on technology, e.g., a Salesforce implementation or another CRM platform. Your responsibilities will be:

• 
Assisting in designing winning commercial strategies and delivering commercial excellence projects

• 
Conducting qualitative and quantitative analyses to identify, understand, and address client challenges

• 
Effectively visualising and communicating complex analyses to client

• 
Performing analyses of commercial processes in sales and service functions to define one global operating model

Your skills and experience

To succeed in the role, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferably, you have knowledge or experience with strategic management, commercial excellence, or sales- and service processes. As a person, you have a high level of drive and like to have a responsibility, where you continuously seek to improve the quality of your work. You are curious, learn to dare, and are comfortable in teams with an empathic mindset. You have the following skills and experience:

• 
You are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business and have demonstrated a strong academic performance

• 
You have student job or internship experience from a consulting company or commercial experience from a C25 company

• 
You have a strong commercial mindset, seeking to improve sales and profitability

• 
You have an interest in working in the field between business and technology

• 
You can communicate complex problems and solutions in a simple understandable way, both verbally, in writing, and visually

• 
You have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels

• 
You have excellent language skills in English

You should be able to work 2-3 days a week, however, we also understand that you must attend to and prioritise your studies, and we are aware that there will be times when assignments and exams occupy you. You will get excellent development opportunities among highly competent and ambitious colleagues and leaders as well as regular mentoring and feedback to support your rapid development. You will work with a high degree of freedom and extensive responsibility while getting support from your team in an effort to become better at helping our clients create exceptional results continually.

You will get a unique opportunity to influence projects and your position in a rapidly developing environment. Last but not least, you will join a culture with a family vibe, a down-to-earth spirit, and a social gathering agenda.

How you apply

To apply for this role, you must hold a valid work permit that allows for employment in Denmark and permits international travel on par with EU/EFTA citizenship rights.

We look forward to receiving your application!

• Have deep technical experience with Business Central/NAV, ideally at least 5 years

DESIGN OF INTELIGENT HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS FOR CUSTOMIZED BRAKING APPLICATIONS

Vejstrup

Can you see yourself working in a well-established Application & Control department with competent and motivated colleagues? Can you envision yourself designing solutions that create safety and security in every type of braking application where large forces or special conditions apply?

Then you might be the next engineer to join the team at Svendborg Brakes.

Develop innovative brake solutions for demanding applications

Together with your competent colleagues in the Application & Control Department, you will be involved in projects related to customer-specific applications. These applications must function in environments such as underwater turbines, submarines, elevators, or at high altitudes in the mountains of Tibet. The applications are diverse and offer plenty of design challenges.

Based on specifications and timelines, projects are led by a Project Manager. This allows you to focus on the technical aspects of the projects as well as managing your own project timeline. Your tasks will include:

• 
Technical adjustments of the core product and components for braking systems

• 
Design and construction of braking systems and components, including hydraulic systems

• 
Leading and ensuring the execution of testing these designs in the test center and production facilities

• 
Preparing technical documentation, including drawings and bills of materials (BOMs)

• 
Participation in development projects, including new material types and customer-specific projects.

Your typical workday will be a mix of independent work and a cross-functional collaboration, as solutions are often found through interdisciplinary collaboration. Among other things, you will work closely with a technical designer who supports you by creating technical documentation.

Svendborg Brakes has its own hydraulic manufacturing and test center, where designs can be tested and where customers visit to follow the project progress. This means you will be able to see your projects through from start to finish.

You are passionate about engineering and intelligent hydraulic systems

We are looking for an engineer with a strong passion for engineering and hydraulics. You have both an interest in and experience with mechanical design, hydraulics, and electrical control systems, and you are motivated by continuously developing your skills. You most likely hold a degree in mechatronics or mechanical engineering and have at least three years of professional experience.

You take a structured approach to your work and maintain a strong overview of tasks and processes. You understand that respecting specifications and timelines leads to the best results and strongest collaboration. You communicate effectively with people from different professional backgrounds and interact effortlessly with both customers and colleagues across departments.

In addition, you are fully comfortable communicating in English, both verbally and in writing.

Do you want to join the team?

At Svendborg Brakes, you will experience a flat organizational structure and an informal culture, where you have the freedom to plan your own workday and the projects you are involved in. You will also be part of a close cross-functional collaboration, where colleagues complement each other across projects with their individual areas of expertise.

Svendborg Brakes’ willingness and motivation to explore new technologies - as one of the world leaders in this field - is evident throughout the company. In other words, you will join a team with high level of expertise and a strong dedication to continuous development. This gives you a unique opportunity to develop your skills based on your interests and motivation.
